name: comp-74
title: Textarea Character Counter
blurb: Textarea with a live character counter displaying remaining space.
description: A textarea that tracks character count and displays remaining characters in real time, with aria-live announcements for screen reader users.
use_when: You need to enforce character limits and give users immediate feedback on available space.
avoid_when: When character limits are not required or validation happens server-side only.
a11y: Counter is linked via aria-describedby, uses aria-live=polite for dynamic updates, and role=status for screen readers.
